Owen hopes to visit Chengdu one day. Both of them like noodles and tea. Owen's favorite animal is the rabbit. Warm milk with honey helps me sleep.
Lily's birthday is in September. They took many photos at the food festival. It takes twenty minutes to get to the kitchen table by bike.
